item.title: Real life
item.description:
Is It Real?

You may have asked this question today, haven’t you? I would guess that yes in case you watched some ‘perfect’ videos on the social medial you like the most. Well, if you asked yourself, I do not blame you. Specially with AI now, very likely questioning what is real will be around for a long time.

This is one of the reasons why I decided to create this blog, to share real life experiences of a software engineer in a world where it seems there is no more reality, where everyone seems perfect, super efficient with no flaws building rocket-science projects.

item.title: About me
item.description:
Hey there, Cris here!

Welcome aboard!

I am a software engineer that loves learning and sharing knowledge and experiences of real life. My entire carrer has been around Python ecosystem 🐍 and its frameworks as well as the countless additional tools a software engineer must handle.

Building scale applications applying software architecture and system design are the main aspects that I like the most in software engineering industry. My technical journey is strongly rooted in curiosity and studies about how to develop system design, architecture, testable and high quality code, always trying to make complex systems work seamlessly, simply and efficiently.
